Compass Core AI

Systems that do the work, with a person in charge.

We map how work actually moves through an organization, then build AI-assisted systems around it: intake, follow-up, reporting, and the handoffs that fall through the cracks. We design for the days when things go wrong, not only the demo.

01

AI workflow design and automation

Agent-assisted workflows that connect to the tools you already use, such as Google Workspace, Shopify, and your email and calendar, with an approval step wherever a decision carries weight.

02

Websites and digital operations

Websites, internal dashboards, and the automations behind them, built together so the information your team relies on stays current without anyone copying it by hand.

03

Operational audits

A structured look at where time, money, and information leak out of your operation, followed by a prioritized plan: what to fix by hand, what to automate, and what to leave alone.

04

Systems for recovery and human services

Workflow tools for recovery housing, peer support, and care-coordination teams, designed by people who have directed those programs. Consent, privacy, and human escalation are built in from the start.

In active development

Ennette

Our multi-agent framework. It coordinates specialized AI agents on a task, pauses for approval when it should, resumes where it left off, and keeps a readable record of what each agent did and why.

In active development

Life Engine

A structured workflow engine for recovery programs, productivity routines, and personal planning. It runs small, repeatable loops such as daily planning and check-ins, and asks before it acts on anything outside the plan.

In design

Voice Security

A voice-based identity app that lets people confirm who they are by how they speak. It is built on sovereign-identity principles: your voiceprint belongs to you, stays under your control, and is used only with your consent.

How we build

Approval before action

Anything consequential, such as sending, spending, or changing records, waits for a person to confirm it.

Scoped, consented data

Each system sees only what it needs. Access is explicit, logged, and easy to revoke.

Measured pilots

We start with one workflow and a short pilot, and report real numbers: time saved, errors, and overrides.

No lock-in

Workflows are written to move between AI providers, so a vendor's pricing change never strands you.

Working together

  1. ConversationA short call about what's slowing your team down and what a good outcome looks like.
  2. AuditWe map the workflow as it really runs today and pick the single best place to start.
  3. PilotWe build that one workflow and run it alongside your team, measuring the results.
  4. ScaleIf the numbers hold up, we extend it. If they don't, you keep the audit and the plan.

Compass Core Studios · Objects

A cabinet of forms that seem almost alive.

Each piece conceals a practical purpose beneath its grain, glow, and unfamiliar geometry. We pair live-edge wood and luminous resin with forms we model and print in-house, and every object is made to be used.

Planters and printed objects

Self-watering planters, modular enclosures, and storage systems, designed in-house and printed in small runs on a Bambu Lab P2S with multi-material AMS 2 Pro.

Sculpture and series

Bio-surrealist sculptural work, including the Aurum Rift series: limited, documented pieces that sit between object and artwork.

AI-generated video

Commercial spots and short films for artists, makers, and small brands, created with AI video generation and edited to a finished cut. We work from your concept, artwork, and images, and can fold in footage you already have. Delivered in the formats you need for web, social, and presentations.

Commissions

Tell us the space, the use, and the size. We'll send sketches, material options, and a timeline before anything is cut, poured, or rendered.

Anatomy · The self-watering planter

A living system disguised as an object.

Integrated layers keep moisture below the soil, so plants drink on their own schedule, not yours.

Exploded view / 01
01

Upper plant basket

A removable, breathable insert keeps the growing medium aerated and lets excess water drain away from the roots.

02

Capillary wicking cord

Draws moisture up from the reservoir as the soil needs it.

03

Sub-irrigation reservoir

Holds water below the soil line for steady, even hydration.

04

Fill port

Clean, no-mess refills without lifting the plant.

Matter dreams too

Wood remembers.Resin suspends.Light reveals.The hand makes it singular.

03

The machine repeats. The hand interrupts. Our work moves between exact digital formation and intuitive craft until the object feels inevitable, but never anonymous. The same idea runs through our AI work: structure in service of something human.
